modules.title: Module 1: Foundations
modules.summary: Learn the essentials of module 1 for User Experience Intro.

lessons.title: Design Principles: User Experience Intro - Lesson 1

content.text: Welcome to Lesson 1 of User Experience Intro. In this lesson, you'll learn about Design Principles—a fundamental concept in Design.
Core Concept: Design Principles
Every great user experience intro practitioner starts with understanding Design Principles. This lesson walks you through the key ideas, common mistakes, and a practical example you can try today.

content.title: Pro Tip
content.text: The most successful practitioners in Design always practice Design Principles before moving to more advanced topics.

content.title: Common Mistake
content.text: Beginners often rush through Design Principles without mastering the fundamentals. Take your time and build a solid foundation.

content.question: What is the main purpose of Design Principles in User Experience Intro?
content.explanation: The goal of Design Principles is to build a solid foundation you can build on.

content.text: Apply it
Try applying Design Principles to a small project this week. Reflect on what worked and what needs more practice.
